image.title: Portrait of Dante
image.creator: Sandro Botticelli
image.attribution: Sandro Botticelli, public domain, via Wikimedia Commons
image.why: The profile, laurel and red cap that fixed Dante's image for centuries

summary.en: Florentine poet, philosopher and politician. A White Guelph, he was exiled from Florence in 1302 and never returned; he wrote the Commedia in exile and died in Ravenna.

en: Served as one of Florence's six priors in 1300
